🧊 ICE & TOURNAMENTS UPDATE
• NEW: Ice Wall, 1000 studs. Ice tools and crampons
• NEW: Weekly Tournament. Live bracket every Saturday, 6 PM ET
• NEW places: Old Mill, Abandoned Skyscraper, Lighthouse
• Climbing Pass Season 1 starts Nov 2!

Climb real rock with your own two hands — and two feet.

No auto-climb, no ladders. You reach for every hold, one limb at a time. Arms burn out, feet slip, and storms roll in the higher you get. Drill a piton before you fall — the rope really catches you.

▪ 1v1 DUELS and RANKED: 8 ranks, ghost races
▪ Dynos and swing lunges on climbing walls
▪ Rope up with a friend — their fall can pull you off
▪ Wind, fog, rain, blizzards: wet holds slip
▪ Weekly boards, replays, race your own ghost
▪ Shop: shoes, harnesses, helmets, ice tools
▪ Map editor: build with friends
▪ PC, phone and console

CONTROLS (PC, rebindable)
LMB — grab · RMB — undo · Q E Z C — pick a limb
F — piton · X — unclip · V — chalk · SPACE — let go
